statement: In a real MLP-Mixer/CIFAR-10 setting, GLU accelerates optimization while providing limited advantage in reducing the generalization gap at matched training loss.

machine_contract.optimization: ReGLU has lower 0-15 epoch training-loss AUC in at least 2 of 3 paired seeds.
machine_contract.gap: The seed-level mean ReGLU-minus-ReLU conditional gap has absolute value below 0.10 cross-entropy, its 95% t interval contains zero, and fewer than 2 seeds show a ReGLU advantage larger than 0.10.
machine_contract.falsification: At least 2 seeds show >0.10 lower ReGLU gap and the 95% interval lies wholly below -0.10.
assumptions: official MLP-Mixer code path with declared dim=64/depth=2 capacity
